name: [QUIRK AWAKENINGS] Heroes Awakening
desc:
Welcome to Heroes Awakening!
PRESS THE BUTTON ON TOP LEFT AND FOLLOW THE STEPS FOR A FREE UGC!
Find the NPC for access to the new update!

Controls:
Hold Space To Downsmash 
CTRL - Sprint 
Q - Dash 
F - Block 
x2 Space - Double Jump
B - Grip 
M - Menu 

🎉UPDATES COMING🎉
The game is still in its early stages! Expect bugs and changes.

You can rank up/prestige at the NPC next to School Building! Raids and Clans are in the menu!

✨New code at 65K likes!✨
CODES: 2RACESPINS2,CHRISTMASUPDATE,CHRISTMASCODE,50KLIKES,GROUP (Like and join group!)
